title: 大学英语四级
description: 四级核心词汇，适合大学英语四级备考。

words.example: She decided to abandon the plan and try something new.
words.translation: 她决定放弃这个计划，尝试一些新事物。

words.example: It takes time to absorb new information.
With patience, you can achieve your goals.
words.translation: 只要有耐心，你就能实现目标。

words.example: Children adapt quickly to a new environment.
words.translation: 孩子们能很快适应新环境。

words.example: Regular reading can benefit your vocabulary.
words.translation: 定期阅读有助于扩大词汇量。

words.example: Learning a language is a rewarding challenge.
words.translation: 学习一门语言是一项有回报的挑战。

words.example: The problem seems complex at first.
words.translation: 这个问题起初看起来很复杂。

words.example: There is strong evidence to support the idea.
words.translation: 有充分证据支持这个观点。

words.example: Try to focus on one task at a time.
words.translation: 试着一次专注于一项任务。

words.example: A little practice every day will improve your fluency.
words.translation: 每天练习一点会提升你的流利度。
